mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.storage_path, DATE_FORMAT(p.taken_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS taken_date, p.location_name, p.country, p.city, COALESCE(pr.provence, p.province) AS province, p.description, p.user_id AS 'uploader.id', u.nickname AS 'uploader.nickname', p.created_at FROM photo p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN provence pr ON pr.id = p.province WHERE p.id = #{id} AND (p.is_deleted IS NULL OR p.is_deleted = 0)

SELECT id FROM photo WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND (taken_date > #{takenDate} OR (taken_date = #{takenDate} AND id > #{id})) ORDER BY taken_date ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
